map.衡量材料温度变化传导快慢: Gauges how fast temperature changes propagate in a material
map.alpha = k/(rho*c)。大 alpha 材料内部温度迅速均匀（如金属: alpha = k/(rho*c). Large-alpha materials equalize temperature quickly inside (e.g. metals); small-alpha heat up slowly and insulate (e.g. wood, insulation).
map.k 是传热的「速率上限」、alpha 是「温度均化快慢」；两者都大才既快又匀。: k is the 'rate ceiling' of heat transfer, alpha is the 'speed of temperature equalization'; both large means fast and uniform.
map.热扩散率和导热系数区别？: What is the difference between thermal diffusivity and thermal conductivity?
map.k 管「传多快」，alpha=k/(rho*c) 管「温度响应多快」；高热容会拖: k governs 'how fast it transfers', alpha=k/(rho*c) governs 'how fast temperature responds'; high heat capacity slows equalization (small alpha).
map.为什么金属摸起来凉？: Why do metals feel cool to the touch?
map.金属 k 与 alpha 都大，手触即把热快速导走、表面温降快，故觉凉（实际温度: Metals have large k and alpha; touching draws heat away fast and surface cools quickly, so they feel cool (actual temperature is the same as the environment).
